info.name: Subscription Billing API (demo)
info.description:
Zero-edit walkthrough of the subscription billing API. Every request works as-is: just click Send (or run the whole collection with Runner).

Before you start:
1. `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed`
2. `php artisan serve` (http://localhost:8000)

How it works:
- The collection pre-request script looks up seeded IDs (plans by code, the Beta Retail customer, a Globex customer, an invoice) the first time and caches them in collection variables.
- Idempotency keys, plan codes and external IDs are generated on each send, so requests never collide on a re-run.
- Subscription requests create a fresh customer + subscription in their pre-request script, so they can be sent repeatedly in any order.
- Each request has tests that check the expected status code.

Rate limit: the API allows 60 requests per minute per key. A full Runner pass uses about 45, so wait one minute between full runs (single Send clicks are fine).

Amounts are in paise (INR). Dates are computed in UTC, matching the app timezone.
